q: According to John Adams, teaching is a bipolar process. The two poles are:
exp: Adams viewed teaching as a face-to-face interaction between the teacher and the learner.

q: The project method of teaching was popularised by:
exp: Kilpatrick developed the project method on the basis of John Dewey's philosophy.

q: In Edgar Dale's Cone of Experience, the base of the cone (most concrete) is:
exp: Dale placed direct experience at the bottom and verbal symbols at the top.

q: Microteaching was first developed at:
exp: Dwight Allen and colleagues developed it at Stanford in the early 1960s.

q: In Herbart's five formal steps, the step that follows 'presentation' is:
exp: The order is preparation, presentation, comparison (association), generalisation, application.

q: The word 'curriculum' is derived from the Latin word 'currere', which means:
options: to run a race or course
exp: Curriculum originally meant a race course or track to be run.

q: Formative assessment is conducted:
options: only at the end of the year
during the learning process to improve teaching and learning
exp: It gives continuous feedback, so that gaps can be corrected immediately.
sub: Evaluation, formative and summative assessment, CCE

q: A blueprint of a question paper is a:
options: three-dimensional chart showing weightage to objectives, content and question forms
exp: The blueprint ensures balanced coverage of objectives, content and types of questions.

q: The validity of a test refers to:
options: the extent to which it measures what it is meant to measure
exp: A valid test measures the intended attribute.

q: The main purpose of a diagnostic test is to:
options: identify the specific weaknesses of learners and their causes
exp: Diagnostic testing locates learning difficulties for remediation.

q: The term 'action research' was first used by:
exp: Kurt Lewin introduced the term in the 1940s.

q: SWAYAM is:
options: a social media site only for teachers
a national platform that offers free online courses (MOOCs) to learners in India
exp: SWAYAM is the Government of India MOOC platform from the Ministry of Education.

q: The school structure proposed in NEP 2020 is:
exp: The 5+3+3+4 design replaces the earlier 10+2 structure.

q: Which of the following is the most important quality of a good teacher?
exp: Understanding learners together with command of the subject makes teaching effective.

q: Which of the following is NOT a core element of computational thinking?
exp: The core elements are decomposition, pattern recognition, abstraction and algorithm design.

q: The maxim 'from concrete to abstract' in teaching means that a teacher should:
options: begin with definitions and later show examples
begin with real objects or examples before introducing ideas and symbols
teach only the abstract part of every topic
avoid examples when the topic is difficult
exp: Learners grasp ideas more easily when they first see or handle concrete things.

q: The major weakness of the lecture method is that:
exp: The lecture method is teacher-centred and gives little scope for learner activity.

q: Which of the following is a purely audio aid?
exp: Radio gives only sound; film combines sound and picture.

q: A typical microteaching lesson lasts about:
options: 5 to 10 minutes with a small group of students
40 to 45 minutes with a full class
exp: Microteaching scales down time, class size and content.

q: Which of the following is the last step of the Herbartian plan?
exp: Learners apply the generalised rule to new situations at the end.

q: The hidden curriculum refers to:
options: the syllabus printed in the textbook
unplanned values and attitudes learnt through school life and culture
exp: Hidden curriculum is learned implicitly from the school environment and teacher behaviour.

q: Summative assessment is mainly used to:
options: judge the overall achievement at the end of a course
exp: It is used for grading, certification and promotion.
sub: Evaluation, formative and summative assessment, CCE

q: A major limitation of essay-type questions is:
options: they cannot test organisation of ideas
exp: Different examiners may give different marks to the same answer.

q: The reliability of a test refers to:
options: the consistency of the test scores
exp: A reliable test gives similar results on repeated administration.

q: Remedial teaching is given to:
options: students having specific learning difficulties identified through diagnosis
every student at the same time without need
exp: It is corrective instruction targeted at diagnosed difficulties.

q: In education, action research was popularised by:
exp: Corey applied action research to improve school practices.

q: The full form of MOOC is:
exp: MOOCs are open-access online courses for large-scale participation.

q: In the 5+3+3+4 structure, the 'foundational stage' lasts for:
exp: It includes three years of pre-school and Grades 1 and 2.

q: Professional ethics requires a teacher to:
options: share marks publicly to shame students
discuss students' family problems with strangers
exp: Confidentiality respects the dignity and privacy of students.

q: 'Unplugged' activities in computer science teaching are:
options: activities done only on the internet
activities that teach computing concepts without using computers
exp: Examples include sorting with cards or searching games.

q: In Morris Hunt's classification, which level of teaching is the highest?
exp: Memory is the lowest, understanding is the middle and reflective level (problem-centred, critical thinking) is the highest.

q: The demonstration method is most suitable when:
options: students need to practise typing speed
the class has very few students
an experiment is costly or hazardous for students to perform individually
exp: The teacher performs the activity while students observe, saving cost and avoiding danger.

q: Which of the following is an audio-visual aid?
exp: A video film presents both pictures and sound.

q: Which is the correct sequence of the microteaching cycle?
exp: The cycle is repeated until the skill is mastered.

q: Instructional objectives in a lesson plan should be written in:
exp: Behavioural objectives can be checked by evaluation.

q: An example of hidden curriculum is:
options: students learning algebra from a textbook
students learning punctuality by watching their teacher always come on time
exp: Such learning is not formally listed in any syllabus.

q: Which of the following is an example of formative assessment?
options: A short class quiz followed by feedback
exp: A short quiz with feedback helps improve learning during the course.
sub: Evaluation, formative and summative assessment, CCE

q: Objective-type tests are called objective because:
options: scoring does not depend on the examiner's personal judgement
exp: The answer key is fixed, so any scorer gives the same marks.
